title: Network Engineer - Data Center Operations
description:
**Network Engineer \- Data Center Operations** 




  





 Location: Bangalore
 



  





**Position Overview** 




 Network Engineer is responsible for delivering onsite network deployment, installation, and maintenance services. The role involves performing rack and stack activities, IOS upgrades, and device health validation for a range of network infrastructure components including switches, routers, servers, and wireless access points.
 



  





 This position requires hands\-on technical expertise, attention to detail, and effective coordination with remote support and client teams to ensure smooth execution and compliance with service delivery standards and SLAs.
 



**Key Responsibilities** 




**Onsite Deployment \& Installation (Rack and Stack)** 



* Perform rack and stack installation of network and server hardware including switches, routers, servers, and access points (APs).
* Install SFP modules, stacking cables, power cords, and network uplinks as per design and project requirements.
* Ensure proper labeling, cable management, and adherence to rack design and airflow guidelines.
* Mount devices (up to 3 meters in height) securely and safely, following all EHS standards.



**Device Configuration \& IOS Upgrade** 



* Execute IOS/firmware upgrades and confirm version compliance post\-upgrade.
* Validate successful device boot, configuration integrity, and module recognition.
* Collaborate with remote engineers for configuration application, testing, and verification.



**Device Health Check \& Validation (POST)** 



* Conduct Power\-On Self\-Test (POST) validation for each installed device.
* Verify interface status, module health, LED indicators, and power redundancy.
* Identify and report any faulty or non\-functional hardware for immediate escalation.



**Wireless Access Point (AP) Installation** 



* Mount and connect APs at designated locations according to deployment plans.
* Ensure secure installation, correct positioning, and power/connectivity validation.
* Note: This role does not include site surveys or signal validation—installation only.



**Documentation \& Reporting** 



* Maintain accurate logs of all installed devices, serial numbers, and cable details.
* Update rack elevation diagrams and cable matrices post\-installation.
* Provide before\-and\-after photos and summary reports for delivery validation and audit purposes.



**Coordination \& Communication** 



* Coordinate with remote implementation, NOC, and project teams for connectivity testing and verification.
* Communicate installation status, issues, and dependencies proactively.
* Escalate site access, hardware, or environmental issues promptly to the Service Delivery Manager.



**Client Interaction \& SLA Accountability** 



* Act as the onsite technical representative, maintaining professional communication with the client during installation and testing activities.
* Ensure all activities are executed within defined SLAs, maintaining adherence to schedule, quality, and operational standards.
* Participate in service review meetings when required, presenting progress updates, risks, and completion reports.
* Document client feedback and ensure action plans are executed for continual service improvement.
* Uphold client satisfaction through transparent communication, professional conduct, and technical accuracy in all deliverables.



**Technical Skills \& Competencies** 



* Strong hands\-on experience with Cisco, Fortinet, and Aruba network devices (Switches, Routers, Wireless APs).
* Knowledge of L2/L3 networking concepts such as VLANs, trunking, link aggregation, and routing fundamentals.
* Experience with firmware/IOS upgrades, device health checks, and configuration validation.
* Familiar with rack standards, structured cabling, grounding, and ESD compliance.
* Ability to interpret network diagrams, rack layouts, and cable schedules.
* Understanding of ITIL service operations and SLA\-driven delivery frameworks.



**Qualifications \& Experience** 



* Bachelor’s Degree or Diploma in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field.
* 3–5 years of experience in on\-site network installation or service delivery engineering.
* Practical experience with Cisco IOS or equivalent enterprise network operating systems.
* Proven track record in executing rack installation, IOS upgrades, and post\-installation validation.
* Experience with ServiceNow or ITSM ticketing systems preferred.
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and communication skills.



**Physical \& Site Requirements** 



* Ability to lift and install equipment (up to 10–15 kg).
* Comfortable working at installation heights up to 3 meters.
* Compliance with all site safety, ESD, and physical handling protocols.



**Key Deliverables** 



* Successful rack and stack of network devices per design and compliance standards.
* Verified device health and validated IOS upgrades.
* Comprehensive post\-installation documentation and photo evidence.
* 100% SLA adherence for onsite service activities.
* Client acknowledgment of service completion and satisfaction.

description:
**About Revolut**
 People deserve more from their money. More visibility, more control, and more freedom. Since 2015, Revolut has been on a mission to deliver just that. Our powerhouse of products — including spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more — help our 70\+ million customers get more from their money every day.
   

  

 As we continue our lightning\-fast growth,‌ 2 things are essential to our success: our people and our culture. In recognition of our outstanding employee experience, we've been certified as a Great Place to Work™. So far, we have 13,000\+ people working around the world, from our offices and remotely, to help us achieve our mission. And we're looking for more brilliant people. People who love building great products, redefining success, and turning the complexity of a chaotic world into the simplicity of a beautiful solution.
   

  

**About The Role**
 Our Technology team builds the systems and experiences that keep Revolut moving. From the infrastructure behind our innovative app to the features used by millions of people around the world, they bring sharp thinking, speed, and a focus on meaningful impact to everything they do.
   

  

 We're looking for a Network Engineer to design and maintain the global network infrastructure that connects our offices, cloud environments, and critical financial partners. You'll build automated, scalable, and secure network services that enable our teams to move fast while meeting the highest regulatory and security standards.
   

  

 Up to shape what's next in finance? Let's get in touch.
   

  

**What You'll Be Doing**
* Designing and supporting high\-availability networks across global offices, Azure/GCP, and financial partners
* Leading mid\-sized projects from initial planning through deployment and performance optimisation
* Managing WAN, LAN, SD\-WAN, and SASE environments using Cisco, Fortinet, Zscaler, and Cloudflare
* Optimising global wireless infrastructure, including capacity planning and conducting surveys
* Ensuring compliant connectivity to banking partners and regulated environments
* Driving automation via Terraform and Ansible to standardise configurations and improve efficiency
* Integrating network systems with monitoring and security platforms using APIs
* Exploring AI\-driven solutions to enhance incident response and performance monitoring
* Collaborating with security teams to implement zero\-trust principles and robust segmentation
* Managing vendor relationships and tracking SLAs to ensure peak service performance

title: Network Engineer SONiC
description:
**Introduction**
 The IBM Cloud Infrastructure Networking organization seek developing and operating the software platforms for large\-scale data center networking environments. These platforms support high\-performance switching fabrics used for cloud services, storage networks, and next\-generation compute clusters including AI and HPC workloads.
   

  

 A key component of the platform is SONiC (Software for Open Networking in the Cloud), an open\-source network operating system designed for scalable, vendor\-agnostic switching infrastructure. The SONiC Software Engineer contributes directly to the design, implementation, and improvement of the SONiC ecosystem and related networking services.
   

  

 This role focuses on building reliable, scalable networking software that runs on modern switching platforms and integrates with data center automation and observability systems.
   

  

**Your Role And Responsibilities**
 The SONiC Software Engineer is responsible for developing and maintaining components of the SONiC network operating system and associated tooling used in large\-scale data center environments. The role requires strong Linux development skills, solid networking knowledge, and the ability to design distributed systems that interact with switching hardware.
   

  

 The Engineer works on control\-plane services, system integration, platform enablement, and performance optimization to ensure reliable network operations across high\-density switching environments.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities \-
   

  

* Design and develop software components within the SONiC network operating system
* Implement new networking features across switching and routing subsystems
* Contribute to SONiC architecture including containerized services and system orchestration
* Develop software modules interacting with the Switch Abstraction Interface (SAI) and hardware forwarding pipelines
* Integrate routing stacks and control plane services such as BGP, EVPN, and routing protocols
* Develop platform support for switching hardware including system drivers and monitoring interfaces
* Troubleshoot and resolve software defects impacting control plane behavior or forwarding functionality
* Optimize performance and scalability for large\-scale data center fabrics
* Build automation tools and test frameworks for validating software releases
* Participate in system integration testing and feature validation across multiple hardware platforms
* Collaborate with network architects and infrastructure engineers to translate operational requirements into software features
* Contribute to the SONiC open\-source ecosystem and maintain code quality standards


**Preferred Education**
 Master's Degree
   

  

**Required Technical And Professional Expertise**
* Experience developing software in C, C\+\+, Go, or Python
* Strong experience with Linux systems programming and networking
* Good understanding of networking fundamentals including Ethernet switching, TCP/IP networking, and routing protocols
* Understanding of VLAN, VXLAN, and EVPN concepts
* Experience debugging distributed or multi\-process systems
* Familiarity with Github\-based development workflows
* Ability to analyze packet flows and troubleshoot networking behavior using tools such as tcpdump or Wireshark


**Preferred Technical And Professional Experience**
* Experience working with SONiC or other network operating systems
* Understanding of SONiC components such as SWSS, Redis\-based configuration databases, and FRRouting
* Experience with switching silicon platforms or ASIC SDKs
* Familiarity with SAI (Switch Abstraction Interface) architecture
* Experience developing high\-availability or distributed infrastructure software
* Experience with containerized services and microservice architectures
* Familiarity with network automation and telemetry frameworks
* Experience contributing to open\-source networking projects

* Minimum of 3 – 8 years of experience as a recruiter, preferably in the BFSI industry.
* In\-depth knowledge of talent acquisition best practices, including sourcing, interviewing, and assessment techniques.

* Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal, with the ability to effectively communicate with stakeholders at all levels.
* Ability to manage multiple tasks and priorities in a fast\-paced environment, while maintaining attention to detail and meeting deadlines.

**About bp**


At bp, our people are our most valuable asset. The People, Culture \& Communications (PC\&C) function fosters a diverse, inclusive culture where everybody can thrive. As part of an integrated energy company, PC\&C is embarking on a major transformation to be more competitive, responsive, and customer\-focused.


We’re investing in key locations such as India, Hungary, Malaysia, and Brazil, offering an exciting but challenging opportunity to shape a fast\-moving PC\&C function, building teams and structures and driving continuous improvement.


We’re looking for driven, ambitious enthusiasts who thrive in fast\-paced environments and are passionate about people. If you're ready to build something transformative, this is the place for you.

**Role synopsis**


Operations \& Advisory (O\&A) is an internal global shared services and technology solutions organisation within People \& Culture. It is responsible for innovating \& delivering HR services and solutions for bp globally, from a number of Business \& Technology Centres and local delivery teams. O\&A is the first point of contact for HR related matters; the team are policy, process and digital guides, dedicated to delivering the best customer experience.


As a Payroll Specialist you will be responsible for providing payroll delivery services, supporting internal PC\&C, resolving complex queries and providing guidance on payroll issues.

**Role purpose**


To support the provisioning of payroll, analytical and management services in support of accurate payroll delivery for the UK, including transactional support, vendor coordination, and timely and accurate analysis of payroll related research and queries.

**Role accountabilities**

* Subject Matter Authority on Payroll processes. Provides support, guidance and training for less experienced team members.
* Prepare and supervise payroll data ensuring processes and data are in place for payroll processing per country requirements and regulations.
* Work in coordination with the outsourced service provider to ensure gross to net data is prepared and submitted in time, review pre\-payroll run data and verification, and provide final sign off to vendor prior to final payroll runs to employees.
* Conduct start of year and end of year payroll administration, preparation and processing activities working with payroll service provider.
* Support audits and regulatory requests for payroll data.
* Handle payroll enquiries and issues.


, • Supervise data quality, running checks during trial payroll period and correcting errors.

* Provide subject matter expertise in all payroll processes and knowledge of end\-to\-end payroll delivery.
* Identify, raise and apply continuous improvements to processes.
* Action submission of prior year adjustments (EYUs/FPSAs).
* Management of manual data entry for leave of absence e.g. family leave/unpaid leave/sickness, fuel card deductions, equity awards etc.
* Management of the overpayments and reclaim process, liaising with PC\&C to ensure consistent application of the overpayment policy.
* Analysing system integration data, identifying and fixing feed errors.

**Required qualifications**


Bachelor's degree or equivalent in Payroll Administration, Human Resources, or another relevant field.

**Other Requirements**


Required to work UK business hours and UK working days as per UK calendar.

**Skills (cross referenced to Capability Framework)**

* Psychological safety
* Continuous learning
* Legal and regulatory environment and compliance
* Stakeholder management
* Continuous improvement
* Organizational knowledge
* Analytical thinking
* Agile core principles
* Resilience
* Teamwork
* Coaching
* Customer centric thinking

**Essential Experience and Job Requirements:**

* Required at least 5 years’ UK Payroll experience in both hourly and salaried payrolls, processing for both, current month and a month in arrears.
* Required to have worked with UK Payroll within the last 12x months.
* At least 5 years’ experience of working with high volume payroll in excess of 12,000 headcount.
* Proficiency in using SAP (ADP Global View) and Workday systems.
* Validated experience in dealing with UK pensions (preferably NEST, Aegon). Pension uploads; reconciliation; error investigation and correction.

**Technical**

* Consistent record in handling payroll deliveries within the team in a shared service environment in a multi\- national organization.
* Demonstrates ability to administer P\&C systems and processes efficiently and effectively, for payroll area / process, including the understanding of legal, fiscal and regulatory requirements.
* Risk Management – acts with high level of integrity and respect for data privacy. Takes steps to mitigate against risks in this space and knows when to call out any concerns.
* Developing capability to reconciliations, payroll data management and identifying errors with minimum supervisory assistance.
* Experienced knowledge of Payroll systems and reporting extraction and running of macros.
* Advance Excel abilities to enable macros and payroll checking excel formatted sheets (data analysis; formulas; v\-lookup; concatenate function; etc.).
* Ability to work under pressure under tight deadlines; effectively multitask and prioritise work in a demanding business environment to ensure goals and deadlines are met.
* Sound knowledge of UK statutory requirements and regulations (birthing parent; adoption; shared parental pay; sickness; etc).
* Ability to switch between hourly and salaried payrolls in the same month.
* Ability to perform manual Gross to Net calculation.
* Sound knowledge of UK NMW rates; NI categories; employee’s and employer’s NI contribution calculations; student loan processing; court order processing; termination calculations; additional holiday pay calculations.
* Experience in processing expats.
* Experience in SSL uploads and report building in SAP (ADP).
* Sound knowledge of prior year adjustments (EYUs/FPSAs) submission.
* UK Tax knowledge and ability to identify payroll\-related legislation and tax regulations.
* Strong financial acumen in handling monthly recons in benefits and general ledgers/cost centres.
* Analysis of monthly integration error logs and application of corrective actions.
* Experience in data validation between different systems.
* Ability to convey technical payroll concepts/issues to all levels.

* Strong numeracy and interpretative skills.
* Analytic/logic approach to problem solving and ability to apply judgement and common sense.
* Ability to proactively recognize and resolve issues.
* Integrity and approachability to discuss sensitive and confidential issues.

**Behavioural**

* Customer focus – puts the customer and business strategy at the heart of decision making. Ability to guide leaders through choices to best suit business requirements.
* Relationship management – ability to build and maintain relationships with customers. Able to build and apply skills through active listening and communicate optimally (written and verbal).
* Solutions focus – seeks to determine solutions and make improvements to processes which will contribute to the business and enhance ways of working.
* Externally orientated – actively working on developing external connections, aware of standard process and actively learns from others.
* Ability to coordinate projects that impacts payroll and provide guidance to collaborators ensuring compliance and accuracy.
* Collaborator management \- ability to build and manage relationships with key business stakeholders.
* Knows when to seek support from other subject matter authorities.
* Excellent personal organisational skills – good balance of being proactive and reactive; ability to handle multiple priorities and complete tasks on time.
* Acts with integrity; living and breathing the bp values of Safety, Respect, Perfection, Courage and One Team in every interaction.
* Works well independently and as a member of the team, proactively providing support to colleagues on daily tasks and workload peaks.

title: UX Design Intern
description:
UI/UX Design Intern

**Location:** Jaipur

**Company:** Exackt Techfleeters (OPC) Pvt Ltd

About Us

Exackt Techfleeters (OPC) Pvt Ltd is a dynamic and innovative tech firm dedicated to delivering high\-quality digital products. We pride ourselves on our architectural approach to software and our commitment to excellence. We are currently seeking a meticulous and forward\-thinking **UI/UX Design Intern** to join our product team and help build the visual foundation of our applications.

Job Description

We are looking for a UI/UX Intern who doesn't just "make things look pretty" but understands the mechanics of a scalable design system. You will be deeply involved in crafting high\-fidelity interfaces, building reusable components, and mapping out complex user flows. This is an ideal role for someone who is obsessed with **Figma**, loves organized layers, and wants to see their prototypes turn into real\-world products.

Responsibilities

* **Scalable UI Design:** Design modern, clean, and responsive interfaces for web and mobile applications using Figma.
* **Design Systems:** Assist in building and maintaining a robust design library, including the use of **Figma Variables** (colors, spacing, modes) and **Auto Layout** for scalable growth.
* **Prototyping:** Create interactive, high\-fidelity prototypes to demonstrate user journeys and micro\-interactions.
* **Wireframing:** Translate complex project requirements into functional wireframes and low\-fidelity blueprints.
* **User Research:** Collaborate with our Business Analysts to understand user personas and iterate designs based on feedback and data.
* **Handoff:** Prepare design files for the development team, ensuring all assets and specifications are clear and implementable.
* **Consistency:** Ensure all screens align with brand guidelines and maintain a high level of visual and functional polish.

Requirements

* Currently pursuing or recently graduated with a degree in Interaction Design, HCI, Graphic Design, or a related field.
* **Figma Power User:** Advanced knowledge of Figma is a must (Components, Variants, Auto Layout, and Prototyping).
* Strong understanding of **UX principles**, typography, color theory, and grid systems.
* A portfolio that showcases your process—from initial wireframes to polished, scalable UI screens.
* Excellent attention to detail (you're the type who notices a 1px misalignment).
* Ability to take constructive feedback and iterate quickly in a fast\-paced environment.

Preferred Qualifications

* Familiarity with **Figma Variables** and advanced prototyping features.
* Basic understanding of how designs translate to code (HTML/CSS/React logic).
* Experience with Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop/Illustrator) for asset creation.
* Interest in specialized industries like e\-commerce or inventory management systems.

What We Offer

* **Technical Growth:** Deep dive into advanced UI/UX workflows and design system architecture.
* **Mentorship:** Work directly with our product team to learn how design impacts business logic.
* **Real Impact:** Your designs won't just sit in a folder; they will be the blueprint for our live applications.
* **Culture:** A supportive, tech\-driven environment in Jaipur where innovation is encouraged.

* Paid time off

* Bachelor's (Preferred)

* Design: 1 year (Required)

description:
Instawork is on a mission to create meaningful economic opportunities for skilled hourly professionals in communities around the globe. Our AI\-powered labor marketplace helps local businesses scale, and enables global technology companies to push the frontiers of robotics and AI. Backed by world\-class investors like Benchmark, Spark Capital, Craft Ventures, Greylock, Y Combinator, and others, we’re looking for exceptional talent to reimagine the way the world works.
   

  

**Location:** 
 Kormangala, Bangalore
   

  

**Working Days:** 
 6 Days a Week
   

  

**Experience:** 
 Fresher (0–1 year)
   

  

**Duration:** 
 3 months
   

  

**About the Role:**
 We are looking for a proactive and energetic HR Intern to support our day\-to\-day recruitment activities. This role is perfect for someone who wants to kick\-start their career in HR, enjoys interacting with people, and thrives in a fast\-paced startup environment.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities:**
* Support end\-to\-end hiring for fresher and entry\-level roles
* Source, screen, and call candidates for various positions
* Schedule and coordinate interviews with hiring panels
* Maintain candidate trackers and ensure timely follow\-ups
* Assist in releasing offer letters and completing onboarding documentation
* Ensure strong communication and coordination between candidates and internal stakeholders
* Contribute to improving hiring processes and candidate experience


**Requirements:**
* Good written and verbal communication skills
* Strong organizational and follow\-up abilities
* Proactive attitude and willingness to learn
* Comfortable working in a dynamic startup environment
* Ability to manage multiple tasks at once
* Available to work 6 days a week


**Additional information:** 
  

  

* Free Lunch \+ Snacks Daily
* Cool workspace and fun team environment
+ Exclusive project goodies


**Our Values**
* Empathy, Trust \& Candor We put ourselves in the shoes of our colleagues and customers and don’t shy away from uncomfortable conversations, instead building trust through honest and direct feedback.
* Bias for Action We practice high\-velocity decision\-making, clear\-eyed that we often operate with incomplete information. Growing quickly means it’s OK to be wrong, so long as we learn from our mistakes and course correct!
* Always Be Learning We’re a curious bunch, and with AI transforming our workplace we encourage everyone to learn from each other, compounding our knowledge and experience to help us change an entire industry.
* Act Like an Owner We work long, hard, and smart, building products that delight our users and drive growth. Your ability to impact Instawork is limited only by your courage and conviction, not your job description.


**About Instawork**
 Founded in 2015, Instawork is the nation’s leading online labor marketplace for food services, hospitality, light industry, and logistics, connecting more than 7M skilled workers with local restaurants, hotels, warehouses, stadiums, and more. Our AI\-powered platform serves thousands of businesses across more than 50 major markets in the United States and Canada.  Instawork has been featured by CBS News, The Wall Street Journal, The Washington Post, and the Associated Press. Forbes included us on their Next Billion Dollar Startups list; RetailTech Breakthrough named us Workforce Hiring Solution of the Year for 2025; and Inc. 5000 recognized us as one of the country's top 10% fastest\-growing companies two years in a row. But what matters most is our impact. We're solving real problems for real people, and we’re doing it at scale.
   

  

 Join our team to help us build something that matters! We’re looking for superstars who want to help us shape the future of work. With hubs in San Francisco, Bangalore, and Chicago, city offices in New York, Phoenix, and Singapore, we're back to working together in\-person five days a week because we believe the best ideas happen when great people collaborate face\-to\-face. We also value diverse perspectives and encourage applications from candidates of all backgrounds.
   

  

 Ready to make an impact? Learn more at www.instawork.com/about.

title: Manager - HRBP
description:
**Business Overview \-** 




  





***About Danone Group:***




  





 Mission: Bringing Health through Food to as Many people as Possible
 



  





 Danone is a global leader in food and beverages, focusing on Essential Dairy and Plant\-based products, Waters, and Specialized Nutrition. Our mission is to bring health through food to as many people as possible by creating nutritious products, raising awareness about healthy eating and drinking habits, and conducting our business sustainably.
 



  





 Danone’s dual focus on commercial performance and societal responsibility, combined with an ongoing commitment to innovation and the strengthening of its health\-oriented brands, has resulted in strong performance worldwide. With nearly 90,000 employees and products sold in over 120 markets, Danone has generated more than €27 billion in sales annually.
 



  





 More information can be found at www.danone.com.
 



  





***About Danone India:***




  





 India is among the countries in the APAC zone wherein Danone has its presence. Danone operates in India as Nutricia International Pvt. Ltd, focusing on nutrition with a range of products catering to pregnant mothers, infants, young children as well as adults. These products are manufactured in India and sold nationally under recognized brands such as Aptamil, Dexolac, Nusobee, and Protinex. Danone employs over 1,000 individuals across India and generates a turnover exceeding €170 million. The company's head office is in Mumbai, Maharashtra, with a manufacturing facility situated in Lalru, Punjab.
 



  





 Danone India is a Great Place To Work® certified organization, which reflects our commitment to creating a workplace where people are empowered to contribute meaningfully, grow professionally, and feel a true sense of belonging.
 



  





 More information can be found at https://www.danone.in/
 



  





 Want to learn more about Careers at Danone India? Visit Danone Careers
 



  





**Role and Responsibilities:** 




  





 The HR Business Partner would be engaging with business stakeholders in key HR processes including head count requirement, performance management, people coaching, development conversations, coordinating learning activities, PDR and ASR process facilitation and all HR strategic projects implementation. The HRBP would also be responsible for managing employee relations and union management (if applicable in the Line of Business) which will involve discipline and grievances management, participating in domestic inquiries, managing litigations under various labor laws (if applicable), bottom quartile management and others related activities. Improving existing practices to ensure high \& positive internal employee experience would be key to the role. Collaborating with CBU HR teams for alignment and implementation of HR processes and sharing feedback for process improvements.
 



  





**Human Resources Management** 




  





*Performance Management*



* Deploy Danone People Conversations (C1 to C5\) in line with global processes and complete HR audits.
* Coordinate and manage Performance related processes Performance Calibration, Annual Salary Review and Short\-term Incentives payouts (STI)
* Discuss with line leaders on employee performance matters and plan for employees’ promotions/performance coaching
* Consolidate performance reviews with functional heads and give consolidated data and recommendations
* Coordinate and track PIP plans for bottom quartile performers







*Headcount Management*



* Partner with business leaders for understanding optimal headcount and positions, talent needs identification in line with business goals
* Manage headcount optimization based on business needs
* Partner with business for internal transfers and assessment of talent pool to meet re\-organization needs
* Coordinate and oversee field force hiring as per process and business need







*Talent*



* Deploy IJP process to identify internal talent as per business requirements
* Contribute to talent needs identification and job requisition on sHaRe for managerial population ICIMS, and participate in the interview process as panel with business stakeholders and share feedback for managerial positions
* Train people managers on all HR Processes (Target setting, PDR, ASR etc.)
* Review re\-hire requests and share feedback







*New Joiner Management*



* Support line managers on designing and planning functional inductions of new joiners (managerial) for early performance impact
* Supporting new joiner in knowing teams, important stakeholders, conducting introduction calls for new joiners
* Run HR sessions during the Basic Training Program (BTP) and induction plans for managers on field



  





  





*Attrition and Exit Management*



* Identification of attrition risks through EWS and create mitigation plan to ensure talent availability.
* Monthly attrition analysis with business stakeholders and creating action plan to manage attrition
* Manage exit process along with line leaders, engaging in retention conversations, negotiations, exit interviews etc.
* Advise business leaders on retention strategies for key talent and support on attrition management



  





*HR Policies*



* Suggesting improvements and leading changes in HR Policies and processes from time to time for enhancing employee experience
* Ensure implementation of HR policies and guidelines for the lines of business supported



  





*Rewards and Recognition*



* Co\-ordinate with people managers for R\&R policy and facilitating the process in respective Line of Business (LOB)



  





*Payroll Management*



* Share monthly payroll inputs to central payroll team
* Managing grievances with payroll team related to payroll\-Sodexo, Mediclaim etc.
* Share resignation details and F\&F inputs with payroll team and other stakeholders



  









**Employee Relations and Social Fundamentals** 




  





*Discipline Management*



* Investigate and take appropriate actions\- issue show cause notices \& charge sheets, termination letters etc.\- for noncompliance or disciplinary issues based on investigation reports
* Manage disciplinary issues in the line of business and address employee grievances
* Coach and advise line managers to enable them with strategies of discipline management
* Prepare and participate in domestic inquiries and labor court hearings as and when required



  





*Union Management*



* Manage Union matters and related grievances, demands, expectations
* Co\-ordinate with legal consultants on case\-to\-case basis and guidance



  





  





**Employee Connect and Engagement** 




  





*Engagement Surveys*



* Drive all surveys (Danone People Survey, Pulse survey etc.) and ensure maximum participation
* Create customized action plan based on survey results and employee feedback
* Validate the action plan with functional CODIs for deployment



  





*Employee Connects*



* Regular connect with employees, people managers and functional CODIs to understand areas of opportunities and way forward
* Deploy HR brown bags to gather employee feedback
* Partner with Safety Manager to deploy Health and wellbeing initiatives



  





**Candidate Profile** 




  




* MBA from a Tier\-1 B\-School
* 3 to 5 years of relevant experience post MBA

title: Human Resources Director India and UAE
description:
Cognite operates at the forefront of
 **industrial digitalization, building AI** 
 and data solutions that solve some of the world’s hardest, highest\-impact problems. With unmatched industrial heritage and a comprehensive suite of AI capabilities, including low\-code AI agents, Cognite accelerates the digital transformation to drive operational improvements.
   

  

 Our moonshot is bold: unlock $100B in customer value by 2035 and redefine how global industry works.
   

  

 What Cognite is Relentless to achieve
   

  

 We thrive in challenges. We challenge assumptions. We execute with speed and ownership. If you view obstacles as signals to step forward \- not step back \- you’ll feel at home here. Join us in this venture where AI and data meet ingenuity, and together, we forge the path to a smarter, more connected industrial future.
   

  

 How you’ll demonstrate
 **Ownership**
 Cognite is seeking a Human Resources Director for India and UAE. Based in Bengaluru, this hybrid\-role four days per week in office and reporting into the global People Operations team. You will act as both trusted advisor and hands\-on operator across employee relations, compliance, workforce planning, organizational effectiveness, and policy infrastructure. In parallel, you will partner closely with global People Business Partners and HR counterparts in Norway and the US to support entity growth, compliance readiness, and people strategy in India and the UAE. This is a role for someone who thrives at the intersection of strategic thinking and tactical execution—someone who can design pragmatic, locally compliant policies and frameworks. You balance deep expertise in complex Indian employment law with the ability to translate regulatory complexity into clear, actionable guidance.
   

  

**Strategic Advisory and Partnership**
* Serve as the Senior HR Leader for India and the UAE, acting as a strategic partner to regional and global leadership. You will integrate local market perspectives into the global People strategy to drive organizational effectiveness, leadership development, and compliant, scalable practices across a global footprint, driven in partnership with People Business Partners and People Operations


**Policy Development \& Infrastructure**
* Regional People Infrastructure: Lead the continuous improvement of employee handbooks and policies across India. You will translate complex regulatory requirements (including Labor Codes, Gratuity, PF, ESI) into pragmatic, user\-friendly guidance that balances legal rigor with Cognite’s high\-performance culture.
* Proactive Compliance Governance: Partner with Legal to monitor the evolving employment law landscape, proactively updating policies and manager guidance to mitigate risk while ensuring consistency and scalability across jurisdictions.


**Employee Relations \& Compliance**
* Champion Regional Employee Relations: Own the end\-to\-end ER lifecycle—from complex investigations and performance management to sensitive exits. You will execute these interventions with composure and discretion, ensuring every action is fair, consistent, and strictly aligned with local legislation in each country.
* Build Protective Frameworks: Partner strategically with Legal to design and refine risk\-mitigation protocols and litigation prevention initiatives. You will proactively address compliance risks across diverse jurisdictions and entity structures to safeguard the organization while supporting business goals.


 The Impact you bring to Cognite
   

  

 The ideal candidate brings the credibility, judgment, and perspective of a senior HR leader, paired with the agility and curiosity of a practitioner who values being close to the work. This individual will play a pivotal role in shaping and scaling the HR foundation for India, strengthening alignment with Cognite’s global People strategy, and supporting the continued growth of our UAE presence.
   

  

* Trusted Strategic Counsel: You become a high\-credibility partner to the Country Manager and global leaders, providing the sound judgment required to solve complex people challenges with practical, business\-first solutions.
* Operational \& Compliance Excellence: You establish a "gold standard" HR foundation, characterized by reduced risk, seamless process execution, and a modernized policy suite that managers find easy to navigate.
* Global\-Local Synergy: You are recognized by peers in Norway and the US as a key collaborator who successfully bridges global standards with regional realities, ensuring India and the UAE are drivers of—not exceptions to—global strategy.
* Cultural \& Leadership Elevation: You translate Cognite’s values of Impact, Ownership, and Relentlessness into the local context, directly improving the employee experience and building stronger leadership capabilities through targeted coaching and partnership.


**Required Qualifications**
* Senior Leadership Pedigree: 15\+ years of progressive HR experience, including 5\+ years as a Director or Senior PBP overseeing multi\-country environments within the SaaS or high\-tech sector.
* Regional Legal Mastery: Deep, hands\-on expertise in India’s multi\-state regulatory landscape (including Gratuity, PF, ESI, and Labor Code reforms) and the ability to navigate UAE labor laws and sponsorship rules.
* Scale \& Complexity Expert: Proven track record of building HR infrastructure in hyper\-growth environments, with the ability to manage complex investigations and organizational design independently across a matrixed global structure.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Master's degree certification strongly preferred; advanced India employment law knowledge a plus.
* The "Simplifier" Mindset: Demonstrated success in transforming dense regulatory requirements into user\-friendly, high\-performance policy frameworks.


***Equal Opportunity***
*Cognite is committed to creating a diverse and inclusive environment at work and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive the same level of consideration for employment.*

description:
**Job Description:** 
 Senior HR Manager – India (Shared Services \& Operations)
 



**Location:** 
 India
 



**Reporting to:** 
 Matrix reporting to business and functional leaders
 



**Scope:** 
 India Shared Services (current 50 scaling to 250 FTE)
 



**Role level:** 
 Senior individual contributor \+ people leader (hands\-on HR operations \+ strategic partner)
 



  





**Role Summary** 




 The Senior HR Manager (India) will lead end\-to\-end HR delivery for the India Shared Services organization and the broader India office footprint, acting as the primary People/HR point of contact for employees and leadership. This is a hands\-on leadership role responsible for scaling HR operations, strengthening employee lifecycle management (hire\-to\-retire), and enabling business growth as the India organization scales significantly over time.
 







 The role combines operational HR execution with strategic leadership partnership, workforce planning, performance and talent management, HR analytics and reporting, and compliance. The Senior HR Manager will develop scalable people processes and maintain strong governance, while building a high\-performance, data\-driven, employee\-centric culture aligned with Anderson Global standards.
 



**Key Responsibilities** 




**1\) HR Leadership \& Site Ownership (India)** 




 • Serve as the senior HR leader and “go\-to” HR contact for the India organization, partnering closely with local and global stakeholders.
 



 • Own and drive the people agenda for India in alignment with business priorities and global HR frameworks.
 



 • Act as a trusted advisor to senior leaders, providing structured recommendations on workforce strategy, organization design, and employee matters.
 



 • Lead and coach HR team members (current and future), ensuring operational excellence and consistent employee experience.
 



**2\) End\-to\-End Employee Lifecycle (HR Operations)** 




 • Hiring support and onboarding (offer documentation, onboarding journey, probation confirmation process)
 



 • Employee relations, grievances, and disciplinary processes (fairness, documentation, risk management)
 



 • Performance management cycle implementation and calibration support
 



 • Promotions, transfers, job changes, and compensation administration
 



 • Attendance/leave management governance and policy implementation
 



 • Exit management (resignations, offboarding, full\-and\-final settlement coordination)
 



 • HR documentation, letters, confirmations, and employee records management
 



**3\) Strategic Workforce \& Scaling Readiness (Growth to 250 FTE)** 




 • Build and execute an India HR scaling plan to support phased migration of roles into India Shared Services.
 



 • Partner with leadership on workforce planning and hiring forecasts, organization structure and role clarity, succession planning and internal mobility, engagement and retention strategy.
 



 • Proactively identify HR risks and bottlenecks related to rapid growth and propose mitigation plans.
 



**4\) HR Governance, Compliance \& Risk Management** 




 • Ensure compliance with local labor laws and HR governance requirements across India operations.
 



 • Maintain strong documentation standards, audit readiness, and consistent interpretation of policies.
 



 • Partner with Legal, Finance, and leadership on sensitive matters (terminations, disputes, policy enforcement, compliance risks).
 



 • Own local HR policy implementation and ensure alignment with global standards, while adapting to India context as required.
 



**5\) HR Analytics, Reporting \& KPIs (Data\-Driven Leadership)** 




 • Build structured HR dashboards and recurring reporting for leadership, covering headcount, hiring plan progress, attrition trends, tenure, demographics, performance distribution and outcomes, compensation movements and cost impacts (where applicable), engagement insights and retention risk indicators, and HR operations SLAs.
 



 • Translate data into insights and decisions (not only reporting), and propose corrective actions.
 



**6\) Culture, Employee Experience \& Stakeholder Management** 




 • Drive employee communication cadence and HR presence in the office (approachable, responsive, structured).
 



 • Partner with leaders to strengthen culture, leadership capability, and team effectiveness.
 



 • Ensure a consistent employee experience and high\-quality HR service delivery during scale\-up.
 



 • Manage complex stakeholder expectations across matrix reporting lines and multiple senior leaders.
 



**Success Metrics (KPIs)** 




 • Quality \& speed of HR delivery: reduced cycle times, consistent closure on employee requests, strong documentation quality
 



 • Attrition outcomes: early warning reporting, improved retention on critical roles
 



 • Scale readiness: HR processes established and stable as headcount grows (50→ 250\)
 



 • Hiring effectiveness: onboarding effectiveness, probation success rates, hiring plan delivery
 



 • Compliance \& governance: zero major compliance issues, audit\-ready records and processes
 



 • Leadership satisfaction: strong stakeholder feedback on HR partnership and responsiveness
 



 • Data maturity: recurring dashboards delivered, insights translated into actions
 



**Required Qualifications \& Experience** 




 • 15–17\+ years of progressive HR experience, ideally within professional services, financial services, consulting, or high\-growth corporate environments.
 



 • Strong hands\-on expertise across HR operations, employee relations, performance management, and talent processes.
 



 • Experience supporting multi\-site operations and scaling organizations.
 



 • Demonstrated ability to work with senior leadership in a matrix reporting structure and manage complex stakeholders.
 



 • Strong knowledge of India labor framework and HR compliance best practices.
 



 • Proven ability to build HR reporting and dashboards; strong analytical mindset.
 



**Preferred Experience** 




 • Prior experience in a global or regional HR environment, supporting international stakeholders.
 



 • Experience supporting Shared Services / SSC / GCC build\-up or operating model transition.
 



 • Exposure to HR transformation, process standardization, HR governance, and policy design.
 



**Skills \& Competencies** 




 • Hands\-on execution capability with senior\-level judgment and presence
 



 • Strong employee relations and conflict resolution skills
 



 • Data\-driven decision making; ability to build and interpret HR metrics
 



 • High attention to detail, documentation discipline, and compliance mindset
 



 • Strong communication, leadership influence, and stakeholder management
 



 • Growth mindset and operational resilience in high\-pressure environments
 



 • High integrity, confidentiality, and maturity in sensitive situations
 



**Working Style Expectations** 




 • Comfortable being both the strategic HR lead and the operational executor when needed
 



 • Strong bias for action and accountability; results\-oriented and structured
 



 • Visible HR presence in office; builds trust across levels
 



 • Able to operate independently with minimal oversight while keeping leadership informed

In the future, the role may expand to other regions and provide support for AMERICAS, EMEA \& LATAM.
   

  

**Primary Task \& Key Responsibilities:**
* Recruit and lead a team (initially planned to add 2 headcounts), provide training and plan for resourcing.
* Prepare and manage employment contracts, amendments, terminations, and related documentation across multiple locations, ensuring compliance with global and local requirements.
* Deliver HR administrative documents on time, in line with service level agreements (SLAs).
* Manage end\-to\-end employee lifecycle processes:
+ Onboarding: coordinate with Talent Acquisition, initiate hires in Workday, schedule induction, and support IT/Office Services for logistics.
+ Offboarding: process terminations in Workday, complete documentation, and ensure access revocation.
+ Transfers: support onboarding/offboarding for intercompany moves.

* Initiate and process all employee transactions in Workday (new hires, exits, changes) within payroll deadlines.
* Raise and track tickets/escalations to ensure timely resolution.
* Run and validate Workday reports (monthly/quarterly) to maintain data accuracy.
* Collect required documents and follow up on payroll\-critical activities.
* Respond to employee and manager queries via HR service channels (email, portal, ticketing system).
* Maintain digital personnel files and ensure Workday records are accurate; conduct regular audits.
* Provide HR support, escalate complex issues to Regional Leads, and contribute to training and knowledge\-sharing.
* Ensure compliance with local labor laws and global standards.
* Support implementation of global HR processes, policies, and initiatives.
* Identify opportunities to streamline HR operations, improve Workday functionality, and enhance service delivery.


**Key Relationships:**
* HR Business Partners
* Talent Acquisition Specialists
* Payroll Operations Partners
* Workday Specialists
* Regional Leads, where applicable


**Desired Experience and Qualifications:**
* Minimum of 5 years’ experience in a similar HR services role, with regional or multi\-country support responsibilities.
* Strong command of English, both written and spoken.
* Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Commerce, or a related field.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook)
* Experience with ticketing solutions, HRIS systems (e.g. Workday, SucessFactors) etc.


**Who We Are**
 Glencore is one of the world’s largest global diversified natural resource companies and a major producer and marketer of more than 60 commodities that advance everyday life. Through a network of assets, customers and suppliers that spans the globe, we produce, process, recycle, source, market and distribute the commodities that support decarbonisation while meeting the energy needs of today.
   

  

 With over 150,000 employees and contractors and a strong footprint in over 35 countries in both established and emerging regions for natural resources, our marketing and industrial activities are supported by a global network of more than 50 offices.
   

  

 Glencore’s customers are industrial consumers, such as those in the automotive, steel, power generation, battery manufacturing and oil sectors. We also provide financing, logistics and other services to producers and consumers of commodities.
   

  

 Glencore is proud to be a member of the Voluntary Principles on Security and Human Rights and the International Council on Mining and Metals. We are an active participant in the Extractive Industries Transparency Initiative.
   

  

 We will support the global effort to achieve the goals of the Paris Agreement through our efforts to decarbonise our own operational footprint. We believe that we should take a holistic approach and have considered our commitment through the lens of our global industrial emissions. Against a restated 2019 baseline, we are targeting to reduce our Scope 1, 2 and 3 industrial emissions by 15% by the end of 2026, 25% by the end of 2030, 50% by the end of 2035 and we have an ambition to achieve net zero industrial emissions by the end of 2050, subject to a supportive policy environment. For more information see our 2024\-2026 Climate Action Transition Plan and the About our emissions calculation and reporting section in our 2023 Annual Report, available on our website at glencore.com/publications.
   

  

 Note\*: All applications will be subject to potential background checks. You will be informed if this will be the case. Further information about the processing of your personal data will be made available during the application process. We'll seek your explicit consent prior to processing the data.

title: Network Engineer, Aladdin Engineering, Associate,
description:
**About This Role**
 Role Overview
   

  

 We are seeking a Network Engineering Associate to join our global network engineering team. This role is built for early\-career talent with a strong interest in enterprise networking, infrastructure, and large\-scale technology environments. At BlackRock, we offer an outstanding opportunity to work in an ambitious environment that values learning and career growth.
   

  

 The associate will work alongside senior engineers to support, operate, and improve campus, datacenter, and WAN network environments. They will build hands\-on experience with enterprise\-grade technologies and operational guidelines.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Support the day\-to\-day operation of enterprise network infrastructure, including campus LAN, WAN, and connectivity
* Assist with network monitoring, troubleshooting, and incident resolution under mentorship from senior engineers
* Participate in network changes, upgrades, and maintenance activities following defined change\-management processes
* Help document network builds, configurations, and operational procedures to support audit and compliance requirements
* Work with internal partners (e.g., security, workplace technology, cloud teams) to resolve connectivity or performance issues
* Assist in analyzing network performance data and finding opportunities for stability, automation, and improvement
* Follow established security, risk, and operational controls while accomplishing assigned tasks
* Participate in on\-call or follow\-the\-sun support rotations as part of a distributed team (after onboarding)


**Required Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience in Computer Science, Information Technology, Electronics, or a related engineering field
* Strong foundational understanding of networking concepts, including:
* TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP
* LAN/WAN fundamentals
* Routing and switching basics
* Familiarity with at least one networking area: Campus networking/Data center networking and Network security fundamentals
* Knowledge of SNMP concepts (polling vs traps; SNMPv2 vs SNMPv3 basics) \& Syslog fundamentals (sources, severity levels, forwarding concepts)
* Network monitoring/observability fundamentals (alerts, dashboards, correlation, noise reduction)
* Ticketing/operations platforms for incident workflows (e.g., ServiceNow ITOM/Event Management concepts)
* Network controller/management platforms exposure (e.g., Cisco Catalyst Center/DNAC concepts)
* Exposure to Wi\-Fi build and operations in high\-density environments
* Basic understanding of ITIL or operational support concepts (incidents, changes, problem management)
* Ability to troubleshoot issues using a structured, logical approach
* Strong written and verbal communication skills
* Willingness to learn, adapt, and work in a global, collaborative environment


**Preferred / Nice‑to‑Have Skills**
* Exposure to enterprise networking technologies (e.g., Cisco, Arista, or equivalent)
* Basic scripting or automation exposure (e.g., Python, PowerShell, or similar)
* Awareness of network security principles (firewalls, segmentation, access control)
* Internship, academic project, or lab experience related to networking or infrastructure
* Industry certifications (or coursework toward): CCNA or CCNP (or equivalent foundational certification)


 What You’ll Gain
   

  

* Hands\-on experience in a large\-scale, enterprise network environment
* Mentorship from experienced network engineers and architects
* Exposure to global infrastructure, modern network build, and operational excellence practices
* A structured learning path to grow into Network Engineer / Senior Engineer roles
* Experience working in a context that emphasizes stability, auditability, and continual progress


**Our Benefits**
 To help you stay energized, engaged and inspired, we offer a wide range of benefits including a strong retirement plan, tuition reimbursement, comprehensive healthcare, support for working parents and Flexible Time Off (FTO) so you can relax, recharge and be there for the people you care about.
   

  

**Our hybrid work model**
 BlackRock’s hybrid work model is designed to enable a culture of collaboration and apprenticeship that enriches the experience of our employees, while supporting flexibility for all. Employees are currently required to work at least 4 days in the office per week, with the flexibility to work from home 1 day a week. Some business groups may require more time in the office due to their roles and responsibilities. We remain focused on increasing the impactful moments that arise when we work together in person – aligned with our commitment to performance and innovation. As a new joiner, you can count on this hybrid model to accelerate your learning and onboarding experience here at BlackRock.
   

  

**About BlackRock**
 At BlackRock, we are all connected by one mission: to help more and more people experience financial well\-being. Our clients, and the people they serve, are saving for retirement, paying for their children’s educations, buying homes and starting businesses. Their investments also help to strengthen the global economy: support businesses small and large; finance infrastructure projects that connect and power cities; and facilitate innovations that drive progress.
   

  

 This mission would not be possible without our smartest investment – the one we make in our employees. It’s why we’re dedicated to creating an environment where our colleagues feel welcomed, valued and supported with networks, benefits and development opportunities to help them thrive.
   

  

 For additional information on BlackRock, please visit @blackrock \| Twitter: @blackrock \| LinkedIn: www.linkedin.com/company/blackrock
   

  

 BlackRock is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to age, disability, family status, gender identity, race, religion, sex, sexual orientation and other protected attributes at law.

title: CORE NETWORKING-WIFI
description:
**Job Description**
 As a CORE NETWORKING\-WIFI specialist, you will play a crucial role in managing and optimizing our network infrastructure. Your responsibilities will include configuring and managing Ubiquiti and Cisco Meraki devices, deploying firewalls, and ensuring seamless connectivity. You will also monitor network performance, troubleshoot issues, and implement various networking protocols and technologies to maintain a secure and efficient network environment.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Configure and manage Ubiquiti EdgeRouters, UniFi switches, and Meraki MX routers, MS switches, and MR wireless access points.
* Deploy and maintain Meraki firewalls and Cisco routing/switching infrastructure, ensuring high availability and performance.
* Monitor network health and performance, identifying and resolving connectivity issues promptly.
* Implement and manage routing protocols such as OSPF and BGP for efficient network communication.
* Configure and optimize VLANs, QoS, STP, and inter\-VLAN routing to enhance network efficiency and security.
* Utilize Meraki Dashboard and UniFi Controller for network monitoring, reporting, and proactive issue resolution.
* Ensure network security by implementing and enforcing organizational policies and best practices.
* Perform firmware upgrades, configuration backups, and maintain accurate documentation for network assets.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to align network infrastructure with business requirements and goals.


**Qualifications**
* Minimum 5 years of experience in network engineering, with a strong focus on Ubiquiti, Meraki, and Cisco technologies.
* Expertise in Cisco Meraki products and cloud\-managed networking solutions is essential.
* Proficiency in Cisco IOS commands and a solid understanding of Layer 2 technologies.
* Familiarity with VPN, VLAN, firewall configurations, and QoS implementation.
* Strong troubleshooting skills, able to resolve complex network issues across diverse vendor environments.
* Cisco certifications (CCNA/CCNP) and Meraki CMNA certification are highly preferred.
* Ubiquiti certification (UEWA or equivalent) is an added advantage.
* Excellent analytical and problem\-solving abilities, with a proactive approach to network management.
* Strong communication and collaboration skills for effective teamwork and client interaction.
* A passion for staying updated with the latest networking technologies and industry trends.


**About Us**
 At Zensar, we’re
 *“experience\-led everything”* 
 . We are committed to conceptualizing, designing, engineering, marketing, and managing digital solutions and experiences for over 130 leading enterprises. We are a company driven by a bold purpose:
 *Together, we shape experiences for better futures* 
 . Whether for our clients, our people, or the world around us, this belief powers everything we do. At the heart of our culture is
 *ONE with Client* 
 \- a set of four core values that reflect who we are and how we work:

 .
   

  

 Part of the $4\.8 billion RPG Group, we’re a community of 10,000\+ innovators across 30\+ global locations, including Milpitas, Seattle, Princeton, Cape Town, London, Zurich, Singapore, and Mexico City. Explore Life at Zensar and join us to Grow. Own. Achieve. Learn. to be the best version of yourself.
   

  

 We believe the best work happens when individuality is celebrated, growth is encouraged, and well\-being is prioritized. All qualified applicants will be considered without regard to race, creed, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, citizenship, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, marital status, family medical leave status, or protected veteran status.

=================================================================================

  

The purpose of this job is to execute sales operations through the DSA channel in line with branch plan and objectives by interfacing with DSA partners and end customers to achieve targets. This role coordinates with Risk, Operations and Sales Governance teams to ensure compliant and efficient sales operations and portfolio health. It also drives and executes cross\-selling of ABHFL and ABFC products/ solutions as per branch level objectives. **2\) Dimensions:** *Mention quantitative or qualitative parameters that are relevant for the job and provide a better understanding of the scope and scale of the job.*

**3\) Job Context \& Major Challenges:** Write the specific aspects of the job that provide a challenge (internal and external) to the jobholder in the context of the Business/Unit/Function/Department/Section
================================================================================================================================================================================================================

 **Organizational Context**
Key Aspects:* **Part of the Aditya Birla Capital Limited, Aditya Birla Housing Finance Limited (ABHFL) is registered with the National Housing Bank as a housing finance company under the National Housing Bank Act, 1987\. The company offers a complete range of housing finance solutions such as home loans, home improvement and home construction loans, balance transfer and top\-up loans, loans against property and construction finance. The company acquired its license on 9****th** **July 2014 and has aggressive growth plans.**
* ABHFL has grown at a steady rate while reporting good asset quality despite challenges in the operating environment. While the industry is dominated by five large groups, there has been an emergence of segments like Affordable and self\-employed borrowers, given the high potential in these segments. Despite increased focus by banks, HFCs have been able to maintain their share in the mortgage market. and is poised for rapid growth and plans to grow 5X (40,000 Cr) in the next 5 years. This shall take ABHFL within the top 5 percentile of HFCs in the country.
* **The ABHFL Sales organization works broadly with 3 customer segments – retail (individual) customers, institutional customers (for retail and institutional loan consumers) and builders (for both retail tie\-ups and construction finance), with a major share of the business coming from retail customers. Client segments can also be divided into Salaried and Self\-employed, with both of these having very different preferences and needs.**

**Job Context**
Key Aspects:* **Providing housing finance (to buyers), Loan against Property, Commercial Property Purchase, Lease Rental Discounting and Construction Finance (to builders) solutions, ABHFL caters to a diverse range of customer segments through its various service offerings. Additionally, being predominantly retail driven, the business is characterized by high volume of loan transactions and customer relationships. As a result, ABHFL business performance is strongly impacted by people, process and organizational efficiencies, alongside core business drivers such as product/ solution quality, channel and customer relationship management and risk management.**
* **While unit of sizing up the business is its loan book size, profitability and minimized delinquency are also key business objectives.**
* **Higher cost of funding impacts profitability as well as competitiveness of loan rates that can be offered to clients**
* **For retail customers, identifying and acting on relevant needs for target demographics/ customer segments/ etc., in an efficient manner ensuring process, statutory and regulatory compliance at all times, are key for building business performance and sustainability.**
* **For institutional/ builder customers, understanding and addressing complex business requirements via proactive relationship management and customized solution fitment, while ensuring compliance at all times, are important to gain competitive advantage.**
* The Sales Manager (DSA) – ABHFL is responsible for achieving sales targets through the DSA channel, as agreed with the ASMABHFL, in terms of targeted book size, growth \& customer service objectives.

**Key Challenges*** To build and tap DSA network in order to achieve targets considering factors impacting DSA relationships such as competitor offerings/ terms, existing relationships, mutually beneficial propositions, etc.
* To upgrade financial \& operational know how on industry dynamics, effective negotiation and relationship building, and efficient loan processing for maintaining lasting relationships with DSAs and customers while ensuring portfolio health and profitability
* To drive loan conversion/ sanction/ utilization rates and ensure an appropriate sourcing funnel to meet targets
* To ensure credit quality, effective portfolio selection/ pre\-screening, and work closely with Risk team members to minimize potential NPAs while driving sales and maintaining DSA relationships
* To ensure compliant sales operations at all times, despite sales pressures and market cycles

 **Enabling Skill Sets \& Qualifications*** Critical skill sets required to meet these challenges include commercial acumen, team management and communication, product\-market awareness, and execution skills.
* Education \& experience required to fulfil this profile are a graduate with minimum 6 \- 7 yrs of total sales experience in the Banking/ NBFC space, of which at least recent 3 \- 4 yrs experience should be in HFC sales with good exposure to DSA channel.
**4\) Key Result Areas:** Writethe key results expected from the job and the supporting actions for each of these key result areas (For a majority of jobs typically there could be 4\- 7 key result areas)
===========================================================================================================================================================================================================

 **Key Result Areas** **Supporting Actions**  

Sales Planning and DSA Management  

* Define and execute a plan for target achievement in conjunction with ASMABHFL, considering competitive forces and local trends
* Scan the local market and competitor offerings on a periodic basis, and work closely with DSA network to tweak efforts accordingly
* Constantly review DSA network for effectiveness and drive operational efficiencies to ensure active DSA relationships are working optimally to achieve business objectives
* Provide data for and compile periodic MIS reports for disbursements, profitability, DSA performance, NPAs, market expansion, etc.; also use insights to provide DSA partners feedback proactively
  

Customer Acquisition/ Engagement  

* Identify local business growth opportunities, and refine DSA engagements accordingly
* Work closely with DSA partners on identified prospects for relationship origination by deploying a partnership mindset and sharing product characteristics and USPs effectively to drive favorable closure and customer satisfaction
* Communicate with in\-process prospects and DSA partners to ensure clarity on transaction status and proactively drive for operational compliance to ensure timely approvals
* Deploy schemes to drive DSA engagement, sales and profitability, ensuring dual focus on sales expansion and cost optimization
  

Operational Effectiveness  

* Track and ensure efficient DSA business processes/ operations across the Customer Lifecycle (Sourcing, Approval, Servicing, Collections)
* Drive process efficiencies and faster TATs through interfacing with stakeholders across processes and functions (Risk, Operations, Sales Governance)
* Adopt improved processes and best practices in order to enhance operational effectiveness, productivity and overall business contribution of DSAs for ABHFL
  

Cross\-Selling across ABC products  

* Drive DSA partner efforts as per Cross\-Selling strategy agreed with ASMABHFL, interfacing with end customers/ prospects as required
  

Self\-Development and Internal Stakeholder Management  

* Stay up to date on market developments, DSA engagement practices/ innovations, negotiation and relationship building skills for enhanced customer acquisition and engagement efforts through the DSA channel
* Attend relevant technical and behavioral trainings/ seminars and work on self\-development initiatives
* Coordinate with internal stakeholders for smooth operations and alignment towards achievement of targets
  

Portfolio \& Risk Management  

* Work with the Risk, Operations and Sales Governance teams to ensure adherence to risk management and control mechanisms
* Liaise proactively with DSA partners and end prospects/ customers for clarity on and adherence to risk management measures
* Compile and ensure systematic, accurate MIS on NPAs and credit trends, providing inputs on factors impacting portfolio quality

title: UI/UX Designer
description:
**Product Development**
-----------------------


**Position Overview**
---------------------


We are seeking a Senior UI/UX Designer / UX Researcher to lead the design of intuitive, scalable, and AI\-powered user experiences for a cloud\-native US Healthcare Revenue Cycle Management (RCM) platform. This expert\-level role combines user\-centered design, UX research, visual \& interaction design, AI/ML dashboard design, and cross\-functional collaboration.


You will design interfaces for Healthcare RCM modules (Claims, Coding, Collections, Scheduling, EDI) and AI\-driven, autonomous agent workflows.


The role involves mentoring junior designers, collaborating with Product, Engineering, AI/ML, RPA, DevOps, and Compliance teams, and ensuring designs are accessible, performance\-optimized, and developer\-ready for modern MVC/.NET Core stacks.


**Job Roles \& Responsibilities**
---------------------------------


**UX Research \& User\-Centered Design****:**


* Conduct user research, interviews, and contextual inquiries with stakeholders, including clients, end\-users, and operational teams.
* Analyze workflows for Healthcare RCM modules to identify pain points and opportunities for AI, automation, and predictive analytics.
* Translate research into user personas, journey maps, and experience flows.
* Conduct usability testing for AI\-driven dashboards, RCM workflows, and autonomous agent interfaces.


**Interaction \& Visual Design****:**


* Design wireframes, prototypes, and high\-fidelity mockups for complex RCM interfaces, AI dashboards, and multi\-agent interactions.
* Collaborate with Product, AI/ML, and RPA teams to ensure user\-friendly adoption of autonomous agents and predictive analytics.
* Implement design systems, style guides, and UI standards for consistency, accessibility, and brand compliance.
* Ensure responsive, accessible (WCAG 2\.1\), and performance\-optimized designs for web and mobile platforms.


**AI/GenAI \& Agentic AI Integration****:**


* Design interfaces that leverage GenAI, LLMs, and autonomous agents, ensuring intuitive interactions with AI\-powered assistants.
* Collaborate with AI/ML engineers to visualize model outputs, predictions, and recommendations effectively.
* Incorporate multi\-agent orchestration workflows and automation into the UX, minimizing cognitive load.


**Prototyping \& Validation****:**


* Create interactive prototypes using Figma, Adobe XD, Axure, or similar tools for rapid iteration and stakeholder feedback.
* Conduct A/B testing, heuristic evaluation, and accessibility testing to optimize user experience.
* Use analytics and user behavior data to inform design decisions and improve AI/ML interface adoption.

  

  

**MVC / .NET Core \& Modern Stack Collaboration****:**


* Collaborate with front\-end and back\-end engineers to ensure designs are feasible with .NET Core MVC, React, Angular, Blazor, and microservices architectures.
* Ensure design components and UI patterns are optimized for performance, scalability, and cloud deployment.
* Participate in design reviews to guide API\-driven UI/UX and integration with AI/ML and RPA workflows.

  

  

**Collaboration \& Mentorship****:**


* Work closely with Product Managers, Data Scientists, AI Engineers, RPA Developers, and DevOps teams to align UX with technical and business requirements.
* Mentor junior UX/UI designers on best practices for AI/ML, RPA, and Healthcare RCM workflows.
* Advocate for user experience in cross\-functional design reviews and strategy discussions.

**Candidate Requirements**
--------------------------


* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in HCI, Design, Psychology, Computer Science, or related fields.
* 7–12\+ years of experience in UX/UI design, preferably in enterprise software, healthcare, or AI\-driven platforms.
* Proven experience designing interfaces for AI/ML, GenAI, Agentic AI, or autonomous workflows.
* Strong knowledge of Healthcare RCM workflows (Claims, Coding, Collections, Scheduling, EDI) preferred.
* Experience with cloud applications (AWS, Azure, GCP) and integrating AI\-powered dashboards.


**Technical Expertise****:**


* **Design \& Prototyping Tools:** Figma, Sketch, Adobe XD, Axure, InVision
* **Front\-End Awareness:** HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Angular, Blazor
* **Back\-End Awareness:** MVC patterns, .NET Core (latest versions), API integrations, microservices
* **Data Visualization:** Tableau, Power BI, D3\.js, Plotly, Looker for AI/analytics dashboards
* **Accessibility \& Standards:** WCAG 2\.1, ARIA, responsive design principles
* **UX Research \& Analytics:** User interviews, surveys, A/B testing, heatmaps, Google Analytics
* **AI/ML \& Agentic AI Integration:** Designing interfaces for LLMs, autonomous agents, predictive analytics, RPA workflows
* **Collaboration \& Versioning:** Jira, Confluence, Miro, Zeplin, Git for design handoff
* **Cloud Awareness:** AWS, Azure, GCP for design considerations in cloud\-native applications


**Skillset****:**


* Strong user\-centered design, problem\-solving, and interaction design skills.
* Ability to translate complex AI/ML outputs and RCM workflows into intuitive interfaces.
* Expertise in cross\-functional collaboration with AI, Data, RPA, and Cloud teams.
* Excellent communication, presentation, and mentorship skills.
* High attention to detail, accessibility, compliance, and user adoption in healthcare applications.


**Strategic Impact****:**


* Deliver high\-quality, AI/ML\-enabled UX for Healthcare RCM platforms, improving operational efficiency and end\-user satisfaction.
* Ensure intuitive adoption of autonomous agents, AI dashboards, and RPA workflows.
* Drive data\-driven UX decisions by integrating analytics, user feedback, and predictive insights.
* Establish best\-in\-class UX practices across AI/ML, GenAI, Agentic AI, and RCM systems.

The **QC Executive – Quality Control** is responsible for supporting routine quality control activities in the IVD and Medical Devices manufacturing environment. This position focuses on **hands\-on execution, data accuracy, and adherence to SOPs**, while building strong technical and regulatory knowledge.
